To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we propose a novel spatial profile loss to compute the loss between the source and the target images, (ii) the proposed loss is useful for learning image translation problems, (iii) it is effective in driving the generator alone, and (iv) it is able to synthesize realistic looking images in many image translation problems.
We propose a novel method for learning image translations that enables the generator to distil the content, colour and style of the target image.
